customCodeThemeConfigBlock.label: Custom code
customCodeThemeConfigBlock.cssHelper: Added to every page after the theme, so it can override any style. Shown in the preview.
customCodeThemeConfigBlock.jsHelper: Runs once when the published site loads, not again when visitors move between its pages. It doesn't run in the preview.
customCodeThemeConfigBlock.assetsHelper: Loaded in this order, before the CSS and JavaScript above. Stylesheets are also loaded in the preview, scripts only on the published site. Drag to reorder.
